content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Only Indian citizens may apply. Candidate must be a resident of the city where they are applying for the Junior Technical Supervisor position. Candidate applying in a State should be proficient in the official language of that State. Language proficiency proved by 10th Standard/matriculation certificate showing medium of study in that language or the language as a subject. May be required to travel across the state and other parts of the country; can be posted anywhere in India as per project requirement. Desirable: Experience in Zoho projects or any other project management software (Civil row). Knowledge of relevant Engineering Software; excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills in English and local language (Electrical row). Ability to prepare technical and financial proposals in response to EOIs and bids (Electrical row). Experience in Govt./PSU contracts and knowledge of functioning of State/central Govt./PSUs/Banks. Candidates with notice period requirement of up to 15 days will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract for 11 months with further periodic extensions based on performance and NABARD's discretion. NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice; in normal course by one month notice. No legal claim to regular absorption or seniority. No other part-time/full-time employment, assignment or business during the contract.

content_sections.heading: How Will NABCONS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Preliminary screening / shortlisting on qualification, suitability and experience Interview (in person or virtual), with possible assessment of proficiency in MS Office/ data management Final appointment on decision of the selection committee Medical tests upon reporting at place of posting Shortlisting with reference to qualification, suitability and experience; only the requisite number may be called. Interview may be held in person or through virtual mode. Shortlisted candidates may also be assessed for proficiency in MS Office/ data management. Interview location will be indicated in the call letter; interview travel cost not reimbursed. Final appointment based on the decision of the selection committee.

content_sections.text: Apply only online in the prescribed format between 13 November 2026 and 19 November 2026. Civil applicants use the form at https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/gkPpaeWiCa. Electrical applicants use the form at https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/eYAcg5m7Ej. If a link does not work, copy and paste it into the web browser and fill the details. The declaration on education qualification and experience may be submitted in the online form. Applications by hand or any other mode will not be entertained.
